description: Change an order's rental period, customer, locations or tags. Moving dates can cause a shortage: the call then fails with the shortage details, and a shortage *warning* can be accepted by retrying with confirm_shortage: true. Booqable: PUT /api/4/orders/{id}.

confirm_shortage.description: true to proceed despite a shortage warning.

customer_id.description: Assign this customer (re-applies their discount, deposit and tax region).

starts_at.description: New rental start, ISO 8601 at the company's local time written as UTC, e.g. 2026-07-01T10:00:00Z means 10:00 at the shop. Do not convert to real UTC.

stops_at.description: New rental end, ISO 8601 at the company's local time written as UTC, e.g. 2026-07-01T10:00:00Z means 10:00 at the shop. Do not convert to real UTC.

name: booqable_update_order
title: Update an order
